description: This source file implements serialization and deserialization traits for Skia image info types and related enums for Mojo IPC, including functions to convert between Skia types and Mojo representations, and to construct SkImageInfo objects from Mojo data views.

classes.name: EnumTraits<skia::mojom::AlphaType, SkAlphaType>
classes.description: Traits for converting SkAlphaType to and from Mojo enum representation.

classes.name: EnumTraits<skia::mojom::ColorType, SkColorType>
classes.description: Traits for converting SkColorType to and from Mojo enum representation.

classes.name: StructTraits<skia::mojom::ImageInfoDataView, SkImageInfo>
classes.description: Traits for serializing and deserializing SkImageInfo objects to Mojo data views.

classes.name: StructTraits<skia::mojom::BitmapN32ImageInfoDataView, SkImageInfo>
classes.description: Traits for serializing and deserializing SkImageInfo objects with N32 color type.

methods.name: MakeSkImageInfo
methods.description: Constructs an SkImageInfo object from provided parameters, including optional color transfer function and to XYZ matrix.
